description.en: Loads a tutorial image, data/tutorial/<_fileName>.xa, with its animation of the same name (CMND_LOAD_IMAGE(_imgName, path, 1, _fileName)), places it at _pos and returns its handle.
File name without folder or extension, e.g. "cut0101".

examples.case: A picture shown during a scene (real usage, from ev42010100.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
